epics.title: System Containerization and Deployment
epics.jtbd: When running the product locally, I want to start the full stack with a single command, so that I can verify its real-world behavior and observability.
requirements: R1: Create a docker-compose.yml file at the repository root to start the full stack.
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint to verify that the application is running.

slices.title: Patch existing codebase with docker-compose and health-check
slices.jtbd: When implementing the docker-compose setup for this epic, I want to define the full stack configuration and health-check, so that the product can be launched and verified with a single command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a local development environment
When I run docker-compose up
Then the full stack should start successfully
Given the stack is running
When I access the health-check endpoint
Then it should return a 200 OK status and integration tests verify the startup
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time to first successful local request

epics.title: Epidemiological Material Cataloging and Management
epics.jtbd: When I manage the epidemiology knowledge base, I want to catalog and update materials, so that the information is structured and up to date.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the percentage of accurate and up-to-date materials in the catalog
requirements: R1: Provide a UI mechanism to update existing epidemiological materials.
R2: Provide a UI mechanism to delete existing epidemiological materials.

slices.title: Patch existing UI for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the update and delete UI for this epic, I want to add frontend controls and API integrations to the existing views, so that the catalog knowledge base accurately reflects current protocols.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material
When a user selects to edit or delete it via the UI
Then the frontend invokes the corresponding PUT or DELETE API and updates the catalog
Given the implementation is complete
When frontend tests are executed
Then the update and delete UI components and API calls are verified successfully
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the time taken to update or remove an outdated material

epics.title: Knowledge Base Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents to zero
requirements: R1: Enforce authentication for accessing the knowledge base catalog.
R2: Prompt unauthenticated users attempting to create a material to log in.

slices.title: Patch existing code with authentication checks
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to integrate standard session management into the existing system, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user
When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material
Then they are blocked and prompted to log in
Given the protected routes are configured
When security integration tests are executed
Then unauthorized access is correctly rejected
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% test coverage for protected route blocks
